title: Therapy Homework Carryover Aging
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=therapy:homework
| search status="open"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by theme
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which themess have gone quiet for open therapy homework.
value: Aging open homework highlights where one theme is repeatedly getting postponed.
implementation: Send open therapy homework events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of themess with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which themess have gone quiet longer than they should for open therapy homework.
